'''Wil''' was a cousin of [[Perrin Aybara]] who once planted a bucket of wet feathers to drop on Perrin.{{ref/book|13|24}}

==Death==
Wil's status is unknown, but he was most likely killed by [[Padan Fain]] along with the rest of Perrin's family.{{ref/book|4|29}}
